channel.title: Updates to the Dynamic Heads Beta Feature
channel.description:
### [Update] September 12, 2022 [quote] Dynamic Heads will now be referred to as **Facial Animation**. [/quote] --- ### [Update] June 28, 2022 > This feature is no longer in beta, you can find more information here: [Link](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/full-release-of-dynamic-heads/1849867) --- Hi Developers! Last October we released the [Dynamic Heads & Facial Animation Preview Beta](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/dynamic-heads-facial-animation-preview-beta/1508623). Today we’re making some updates to this beta feature and releasing some new functionality to prepare for our full release of Dynamic Heads and Facial Animation later this year. To use the features mentioned in this post, you will need to turn on the following two beta features in Studio: * Facial Animation * Automatic Skinning Transfer --- ### Update to the Beta Feature The major change we’re making to the beta feature involves hiding the bone instances under the head MeshPart in the Data Model. Previously we’ve shown these bone instances, but moving forward they won’t be visible in any Dynamic Head asset. We’re primarily making this change to simplify the Data Model and avoid any confusion around animating Dynamic Heads using the bones. All face animations should use [FACS](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/facs-poses-reference), which standardizes the animation of Dynamic Heads to a set of 50 controls regardless of the underlying bone count. Below you can see that the Data Model has changed to hide the bone instances under the Head MeshPart.
| Previously|                                     | Going Forward| | :--- | :----: | :---: | | | |
![1|186x500, 75%](upload://z1oR0Mg03FAhdPynR8HI9WCD2ot.png) ![1|107x500, 50%](upload://v9C4tGt7jaOUz2cxImXOc3Ulf6U.png)![2|356x500, 75%](upload://xihy4GRQA6ogGFZR58pNkytMmI7.png)
--- ### Documentation Alongside this update, we’re releasing some fresh documentation, example files, and test scenes to help with creating, implementing, and animating Dynamic Heads! Below is the full list of the documentation: * [Overview](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads) * [Using Dynamic Heads in Studio](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/using-dynamic-heads-in-studio) * [Animating Dynamic Heads](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/animating-dynamic-heads) * [Creating a Basic Dynamic Head](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/creating-basic-dynamic-heads) * [FACS Poses Reference](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/facs-poses-reference) We’ve also updated the example scenes we released last year to reflect the changes in the assets we mentioned above. Here are the links to those place files: * [Dynamic Head Schema Example.rbxl|attachment](upload://dcG90OPHw1a0sWLuOeoxa4zjWh6.rbxl) (183.2 KB) * [Dynamic Head Customization Example.rbxl|attachment](upload://zY1IQEHg9b6OhriKYY53p8lZuwc.rbxl) --- ### Face Animation Editor To help with the creation of Face Animations, we’re excited to release the **Face Animation Editor** into beta! The Face Animation Editor provides an intuitive interface to animate Dynamic Heads using FACS within the existing Animation Clip Editor plugin. More information can be found [here](https://create.roblox.com/docs/avatar/dynamic-heads/animating-dynamic-heads)! ![3|690x419, 50%](upload://9eWoEmsFwv5Px1oHl5cHgTmgERh.jpeg) ![4|690x419, 50%](upload://ldbLgGSx9GALM0sISbLFLSDjOPD.jpeg) --- ### Automatic Skinning Transfer We have also released [Automatic Skinning Transfer](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/automatic-skinning-transfer-beta/1812230) into Beta. This enables layered clothing accessories without built-in skinning to deform properly. By turning on the “Automatic Skinning Transfer” Beta Feature, you will see a new property under the WrapDeformer’s WrapLayer instances which allows the deformation of accessories based on the skinning information of the character it’s attached to. More information can be found here! --- ### Future Plans This release brings us one step closer to more immersive social communication and self-expression through Dynamic Heads and Facial Animation. As a sneak peek, we’re working towards several upcoming releases that will expand the use of Dynamic Heads & Facial Animation: * Full Release of Dynamic Heads and Facial Animation * This will allow developers to integrate Dynamic Head assets in live experiences along with face animations for emotes and locomotions. * Catalog Release of Dynamic Heads * This release will add characters to the Avatar Shop that have Dynamic Heads and are capable of Facial Animation. * Live Facial Animation * This introduces the ability for players to drive the facial animation of their avatar using their live facial expressions through audio and video input. As we move towards the above releases, players will begin entering your experiences with Dynamic Heads equipped. As such, we’d love for all of you to play around with this tech and ensure your experience is well equipped for this new functionality that will become available later this year. We’re continuously working to develop these features and would love to hear any feedback, bug reports, or feature requests from all of you! We have also opened a Beta program that will allow interested developers to integrate Dynamic Heads in a live experience ahead of the full public release as a way to provide us with feedback and suggestions. If this is something that you would like to participate in, please fill out this [form](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://roblox.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0B7oy81tQwJZTIW&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1653505561242802&usg=AOvVaw0NHOdT7Br2tsLfhw9ZDNvX)! We’re super excited to push this tech further and see what all of you create! Please try out this new feature and let us know if you have any questions, suggestions, or if you run into any issues.

item.title: Updates to the Dynamic Heads Beta Feature
item.dc:creator: darkmodeonn
item.description:
Following up to provide some more clarity here.
Long term we’d love for all avatar bundles to include a Dynamic Head, but that may take time. In the meantime we’re discussing how to prioritize which bundles should include a Dynamic Head and it’s likely going to depend on the usage/adoption of those characters. We don’t have an ETA for how long it would take to update all characters to become Dynamic but it’s a long and challenging process that will likely extend into 2023. We’re very excited to see developers like start creating new Dynamic Heads and potentially use existing bundles as inspiration. Let us know if you have any other feedback or concerns!

A few questions:

1- How are facial animations going to work with heads that don’t have distinct facial features?
For example:
Headless Head - Roblox (especially curious to know about this one)
Mech Golem - Head - Roblox
Cyclock - Head - Roblox

2-

darkmodeonn:

The major change we’re making to the beta feature involves hiding the bone instances under the head MeshPart in the Data Model. Previously we’ve shown these bone instances, but moving forward they won’t be visible in any Dynamic Head asset.

Is there any chance we can get the ability to manually set the bone’s properties? I understand you guys want to respect realism but the ability to move the face in unrealistic ways might be useful in some circumstances, for example a horror game or a game that is supposed to be funny, opening the eyes so wide that the eyes spring out of the head might be useful in some circumstances, even if not realistic.

3- How are live facial animations going to work? Is it going to use an app or something? Will I be able to use live facial animations on my computer from my phone since I don’t have a webcam or will it be closer to VC?

Great question! Currently the best way to create a Dynamic Head that is inspired by a 2D face is using one of the template files we provided. You can also create a Dynamic Head from scratch using this tutorial we posted. In the future we’re going to continue building tools and sharing new templates that will help with Dynamic Head creation.

item.title: Updates to the Dynamic Heads Beta Feature
item.dc:creator: darkmodeonn
item.description:
Thank you for raising this issue. We’re currently investigating the root cause but as a work around you could: Click the head, in the properties panel copy the TextureId ( rbxassetid://9738703854 ), then on the head press the plus button to add a SurfaceAppearance. Uncollapse the head, select the created SurfaceAppearance in the head and in the properties panel paste texture id rbxassetid://9738703854 into the ColorMap field.
